responsibility: Declares Graphite’s public data structures and APIs shared across the polyhedral pipeline. It defines the stable representation of polyhedral data references (poly_dr), polyhedral basic blocks (poly_bb), and SCoPs (scop), including their GIMPLE/SESE ownership links and isl objects such as access maps, domains, schedules, and dependence relations. It also exposes helper predicates, accessors, debug/printing entry points, and the main cross-file operations for SCoP detection, polyhedral building, dependence computation, schedule transformation, and AST-to-GIMPLE regeneration.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the public Graphite interface: it defines the core polyhedral objects such as poly_dr, poly_bb, and scop, plus declarations for analysis, transform, dependence, and regeneration helpers used across Graphite sources. Unlike gcc/graphite.cc, it does not drive pass execution or perform the end-to-end transformation pipeline.
